amanda: Quick ask for ZephyrCare POC — they need a single WS for multiplexed streaming, function/tool calls in-stream, strict JSON schema, EU residency + SSO/KMS, and a 1-week ballpark for 500 QPS. Can we get a tiny SDK example, runbook, and legal blurb before tomorrow's demo?

raj: Yes on multiplexing via session_id over one websocket. Hosted can rebalance; recommend Dedicated with sticky routing for ordered tool calls. Ephemeral tokens supported (default 15m).

maya: Minimal Node example to hand them:
```js
const ws=new WebSocket(process.env.WS_URL);
ws.on('open',()=>ws.send(JSON.stringify({type:'open',session_id:'s1',schema_hints:{patient:{id:'string'}}})));
ws.on('message',m=>{const msg=JSON.parse(m);if(msg.type==='tool_call'){ws.send(JSON.stringify({type:'tool_response',session_id:msg.session_id,call_id:msg.call_id,result:JSON.stringify({ok:true})}));}});
```

tom: Runbook (short): 1) Share IdP metadata + KMS ARN. 2) We provision EU test Dedicated pool (2-3 days). 3) POST /handshake -> {ws_url,expires_in}. 4) Open WS, multiplex sessions, include schema_hints. 5) Reply to tool_call with tool_response JSON; make handlers idempotent. 6) Post-demo rotate ephemeral creds.

maya: Legal blurb: "Runtime keeps inference KV caches in-memory only; dedicated/private deployments do not persist raw prompt/response tokens to disk by default. Customers can enable logging; exported logs follow retention policy. Customer-managed KMS is used for at-rest encryption; key rotation follows customer policy. Audit logs for admin/provisioning available via Console per contract."

raj: Ballpark for 500 QPS one-week Dedicated test (EU): ~30k-50k USD depending on prompt length and support level. Formal quote to follow.

ops-bot: Provision event: zephyrcare-poc-eu pool created (pool-id: p-zc-321)

amanda: Great — I'll send to ZephyrCare and book demo for tomorrow 15:00 CET. Ping me for edits.
